integrity: Proof uses explicit reduction to a random permutation, alternating matching cycle decomposition, and finite rook inclusion-exclusion. Finite verification is diagnostic, not proof of the general theorem.
limitations: Only two independent uniform permutation summands over finite abelian groups; exact mean, variance, pair-missing law, and order-four distinction; not the complete distribution in general or a group-isomorphism criterion. No independent priority audit.
title: Image-size variance for the sum of two random permutations detects finite abelian group structure
